business.body: The Cochin Malabar Estates and Industries Limited is a public limited company incorporated in India under the Indian Companies Act 1913, with its registered office at 21, Strand Road, Kolkata and its equity listed on BSE. Its Rubberwood Factory has not been in operation for nearly 28 years following a notice received from the Deputy Conservator of Forests (Protection), Trivandrum, and the Directors' Report confirms the Company had no revenue from operations in either FY26 or FY25 and no manufacturing activity during the year. Present activity consists of earning commission income by assisting clients in developing their business, and developing the Company's own land assets in Goa, on which the going-concern status rests.

outlook.body: The annual report discloses no capex project, no capacity addition and no commissioning or ramp-up timeline. The only expansion-like activity stated is that the Company is developing its land assets in Goa, described without any project name, scope, spend or timeline. The Company's Rubberwood Factory has not been in operation for nearly 28 years pursuant to a notice received from the Deputy Conservator of Forests (Protection), Trivandrum, and the Directors' Report confirms the Company had no manufacturing activity during the financial year ended 31st March, 2026. The Capital Commitments note in this bundle shows the estimated amount of contracts remaining to be executed on capital account (net of advances) as nil ('-') in both columns presented.
